mapper.select: select id, organization_id, doc_id, seq, content, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from ai_knowledge_chunk where organization_id = #{orgId} order by create_time desc limit #{limit}

select c.id, c.organization_id, c.doc_id, c.seq, c.content, c.vector, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.create_user, c.update_user from ai_knowledge_chunk c join ai_knowledge_doc d on c.doc_id = d.id where c.organization_id = #{orgId} and c.vector is not null and d.revoked = 0 and (d.effective_date is null or d.effective_date <= curdate())
